C0441.title: Global Credit Card Fraud Losses Continue to Climb
C0441.summary: Available materials show that global credit card fraud losses rose from about 18 billion US dollars in 2014 to more than 32 billion US dollars in 2022, and card cracking is one form of that fraud. Such attacks typically test expiration dates and CVV security codes, and fraudsters may use automated tools to enumerate leaked or illegally obtained card numbers to identify usable payment card information.
